create_patterns.name: selection-no-load-for-plain-put
create_patterns.content:
# No load for plain put

t1 (put a credit card on the table) and t2 (move keys from desk to safe) both needed pick_and_place. Nothing was loaded. No heat, clean, cool or two-object cue appears in either task, so the default skill applies. Load pick_and_place for any single-object move.

create_patterns.name: selection-missed-clean-when-microwave-mentioned
create_patterns.content:
# Missed clean when microwave mentioned

t5 (put a clean tomato in the microwave) needed pick_clean_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The microwave is only the destination, so it is not a heat cue. The word clean sets the skill.

create_patterns.name: selection-missed-clean-when-wet-or-clean-adjective
create_patterns.content:
# Missed clean with adjective cue

t3 (cleaned soap), t4 (clean fork), t6 (wet napkin) and t7 (clean knife) all needed pick_clean_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The cue is an adjective or state word (clean, cleaned, wet) and not the verb clean. Treat these words as a request for the clean-then-place skill.

create_patterns.name: selection-missed-cool-when-cooled-adjective
create_patterns.content:
# Missed cool with adjective cue

t8 (place a cooled plate in the cupboard) needed pick_cool_then_place. Nothing was loaded. The word cooled is the cue.
